| description = This is a great solo spot for people that need to go AFK often. Good money as she drops 2 fine steel short swords every time that sell for 5pp each. 

=== Strategy ===

Difficult to kill the first time because she buffs herself and will then roam the zone and receive additional buffs from other NPCs. However, she's very easy afterwards if you can attack her right after she spawns and before she buffs. When resting or meditating, sit closer to the water's edge and not in the middle of the courtyard because a low-level ranger, [[Bren Treeclimber]], roams through there. Not a big deal as your pet can kill this mob, but annoying if you AFK often and come back to kill Krystal Aspen only to find that this low-level mob hit you and you have not been meditating this whole time. 

If you get to a point where you have downtime and want some extra XP or loot, you can kill [[Ran Walker]] who is a Druid that spawns near the zone line to [[Qeynos Hills]]. 
You can also participate in the [[6-Minute Bard Diet]] by killing [[Sivina Lutewhisper]] in the house that has the Ranger and Druid GMs. However, take caution doing this. By killing Krystal Aspen, you will eventually be KoS to the rangers and druids in Surefall Glade. Be sure to con the druids and rangers in the building prior to killing the bard.
